notes: Kett "Brood Hold" (Kett heal and work x1.2 here, others x0.8): a chitin nursery cabinet of nine hive cells, each holding a pale larva; on loop (2) the larvae glow in alternating cells as they squirm. A row of three small drone bays along the bottom. Damaged: a cell burst open and dark, the larva gone, a plate hanging, sparks. Disabled: the cells grey and empty, the cabinet cracked, a bay dark.
